module: Telemetry tracker for the hardware performance warnings shown to the player: each warning (category + message) is reported only once per session ("performanceHardwareWarning" event with category, message, severity, context and acknowledgment).

onPerformanceHardwareWarning.desc: Hook called when the game emits a hardware performance warning; deduplicates by category and message.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: manual unload.
